# Corpus texts

Static excerpts used as the long-form sample corpus for the benchmarks and the accuracy bounds. They are checked in as-is and are not regenerated by any script.

The corpus is meant to represent what people actually measure with tokenx: documentation pages, API responses and prose, across scripts. Registers are chosen deliberately – contemporary Chinese rather than classical, because classical Chinese merges at roughly one character per token and would flatter the estimate without representing anyone's traffic.

Each prose file was cleaned once: source boilerplate and markup removed, hard-wrapped lines rejoined into whole paragraphs, one paragraph per line separated by a blank line. Latin-script wraps were rejoined with a space, CJK wraps with nothing. The Markdown and JSON files are kept verbatim, because the raw form is what tooling feeds through an estimator.

| File | Source | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `great-gatsby-en.txt` | F. Scott Fitzgerald, _The Great Gatsby_ (1925) – opening of chapter I, [Project Gutenberg 64317](https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/64317) | Public domain |
| `die-verwandlung-de.txt` | Franz Kafka, _Die Verwandlung_ (1915) – opening of part I, [Project Gutenberg 22367](https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/22367) | Public domain |
| `artificial-intelligence-zh.txt` | [人工智能](https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/人工智能), Chinese Wikipedia – prose paragraphs of the article body, requested as `zh-hans` | CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikipedia contributors |
| `vite-plugin-api-en.txt` | [`docs/guide/api-plugin.md`](https://github.com/vitejs/vite/blob/main/docs/guide/api-plugin.md), `vitejs/vite` | MIT, VoidZero Inc. and Vite contributors |
| `vite-plugin-api-ja.txt` | [`guide/api-plugin.md`](https://github.com/vitejs/docs-ja/blob/main/guide/api-plugin.md), `vitejs/docs-ja` | MIT, VoidZero Inc. and Vite contributors |
| `vite-plugin-api-ko.txt` | [`guide/api-plugin.md`](https://github.com/vitejs/docs-ko/blob/main/guide/api-plugin.md), `vitejs/docs-ko` | MIT, VoidZero Inc. and Vite contributors |
| `github-releases-api.txt` | `GET /repos/vuejs/core/releases?per_page=10`, captured from the GitHub REST API | Release notes by Vue contributors, MIT |

The three Vite files are the same page in three languages, so a deviation gap between them isolates the script rather than the subject matter.

Each file stays under the licence of its source; the MIT licence of this repository covers the code, not these texts. `artificial-intelligence-zh.txt` is the only share-alike text: reusing it elsewhere carries the CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution and share-alike obligations listed above.
